verdict.rationale: Linear documents version history with checkpoint restore for coding sessions and signed commits, giving some ability to review and roll back agent-driven changes, plus Guided Reviews for reviewing diffs. However, this is scoped to individual coding sessions, not a broader automation/workflow versioning system (e.g., Loops, skills) with review/rollback controls. missing for 10: version history/rollback for Loops and shared skills (not just coding sessions), audit trail of automation changes over time, independent/hands-on confirmation that rollback works reliably.
